description: This source file is a PHP web page that provides a user interface for viewing and refreshing SIP packet logs in a network gateway management system. It includes header, navigation, and footer includes, loads styles and scripts, and contains embedded JavaScript for handling user interactions and dynamic log display.

methods.name: document.ready
methods.description: Initializes the page, sets up click handler for the refresh button, and manages AJAX request to fetch SIP logs.
